summary: Manchester navigation beacon may show bearing fluctuations due to a temporary crane nearby.
text:
VOR/DME MCT/MANCHESTER 113.55 MHZ CH82Y THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS
OF DVOR BEARING FLUCTUATIONS WITHIN THE 320-000 DEG. MAG. SECTOR
RADIALS FROM THE MANCHESTER VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO A TEMPORARY
CRANE IN THE VICINITY
